title: Cisco Webex Recording
description: Represents a Webex meeting recording including metadata, download links, and playback information.

meetingId.description: The meeting ID associated with the recording.

topic.description: The topic or title of the recording.

createTime.description: Date and time the recording was created.

timeRecorded.description: Date and time the recording was made.

playbackUrl.description: URL to play back the recording.

password.description: Password required to access the recording.

serviceType.description: Webex service type the recording originated from.

durationSeconds.description: Duration of the recording in seconds.

sizeBytes.description: Size of the recording file in bytes.

temporaryDirectDownloadLinks.description: Temporary download links with expiration timestamps.
